dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: Trump said the United States will strike the Pickaxe Mountain area near Natanz 'pretty soon' and 'very heavily' after being asked about reports of centrifuge relocation. He said material, not machinery, is the key indicator. The target warning materially sharpens the nuclear-site crisis but does not independently establish a current transfer, new enrichment level, inspector-access change, reprocessing, operation or detonation; raw risk holds at 47% and coupling leaves 54% displayed

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN WAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: President Trump said the United States will hit the Pickaxe Mountain area near Natanz 'pretty soon' and 'very heavily', said the campaign is not finished, and ruled out talks until Tehran is ready for a meaningful meeting. AP and ABC/Reuters also report continuing Iranian attacks across the Gulf. This is a new explicit target declaration, but the realized-war lane is already capped at 100%; it does not prove a current centrifuge transfer or device threshold

The verified withdrawal/army-entry step still outweighs this limited disputed incident, so raw risk holds at 76% and Iran-war coupling leaves 86% displayed
